x.Drone Platform Breadth & Payload Versati: Range of drone models (multirotor, fixed-wing, hybrid) and payload options (cameras, sensors, delivery boxes) offered for Indian use cases like agriculture, surveillance, and logistics. Evidence includes number of SKUs, max payload capacity, and modularity.
x.Flight Performance & Autonomy: Endurance, range, speed, and autonomous capabilities (waypoint navigation, obstacle avoidance, BVLOS readiness) of drones in Indian operating conditions. Evidence includes flight time, control range, and autonomy features.
x.Core Drone Technology & IP: Proprietary hardware and software such as flight controllers, communication systems, AI analytics, and patents filed in India. Evidence includes patents, in-house developed components, and software stack.
x.Manufacturing & Supply Chain Localizatio: Degree of local manufacturing, assembly, and sourcing of components in India to meet Make in India and PLI norms. Evidence includes local production facilities, percentage of indigenous content, and partnerships with Indian suppliers.
x.Regulatory Compliance & Certification: Compliance with Indian drone regulations (DGCA rules, NPNT, UIN, RTP) and certifications for operations. Evidence includes type certificates, approvals for BVLOS, and adherence to Digital Sky platform.

y.Domestic Customer Base & Contract Wins: Number and profile of Indian customers (government, PSUs, private enterprises) and value of contracts secured. Evidence includes named clients like Indian Army, state governments, and contract amounts.
y.Revenue Growth & Funding: Annual revenue, growth rate, and funding raised from Indian or global investors. Evidence includes financial statements, funding rounds, and investor names.
y.Geographic Reach & Channel Network: Presence across Indian states and distribution/partner network for sales and support. Evidence includes number of offices, dealers, and service centers in India.
y.Strategic Partnerships & Alliances: Collaborations with Indian entities (DRDO, HAL, startups, academia) for technology, manufacturing, or market access. Evidence includes MoUs, joint ventures, and consortium memberships.
y.Market Share & Brand Leadership: Estimated share of the Indian drone market and brand recognition among customers. Evidence includes market reports, awards, and repeat orders from key clients.

market_definition: The industry encompassing the design, development, and production of unmanned aerial vehicles (UAVs) embedded with robotic software, sensors, and autonomous navigation capabilities.
